usedFor: Slack holds your channel messages, and Predis.ai starts content from them through “Create Content”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Content” in Predis.ai
bestTemplate.why: A message in a chosen channel kicks off a Predis.ai content job, so ideas become posts.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, so a bot post in that channel starts content too.
